note: The OpenZone admin window, hosted by VPP Admin Tools (VPP rework 2026-11-12). The script creates it through VPP's own AdminHudSubMenu.CreateWidgets, inside VPP's Panel_Content beside VPP's windows, and places it on the first show. Only the window's chrome lives here: the ground, the title band, the drag header, the close button, the rail the script fills with one oz_vpp_rail_row per module and per page, the status bar, the confirm strip and the resize grip. THE PAGES ARE NOT HERE: every pane, the core's and the glue mods', is its own layout the script creates under this root and moves into the content area right of the rail, so a mod that adds a page needs nothing from this file. Colours are the window's own vpp* tokens (the trader's metal); the series palette stays the PDA's. Names OZ_VppRoot, VppTitle, VppCrumb, Header, Rail, RailEdge, StatusBar, StatusDot, StatusText, StatusCount, ConfirmBar, ConfirmText, BtnConfirmNo, BtnConfirmYes, Grip and BtnVppClose are read by OZ_VppMenu.c.

frame.name: OZ_VppRoot
frame.note: Hidden: VPP shows the window itself (ShowSubMenu right after OnCreate). No priority of its own: VPP's SetWindowPriorty orders the windows of Panel_Content. Exact position 0,0: the script places the window at vpp.windowX / vpp.windowY of the parent on the first show. The script sets CLIPCHILDREN on it.

panel.name: VppBg
panel.note: The window's ground and its one-unit border. Fill is resolved to the window's exact size here, so nothing follows a resize by itself: ApplyWindowSize in OZ_VppMenu.c resizes the ground, the border, the title band, the rail and the status bar with the window.

label.name: VppCrumb
label.note: The open page: module and page, written by ShowPane.

panel.name: Header
panel.note: VPP's m_TitlePanel: drag the window by it, double-click it to maximize or restore. The script adds WidgetFlags.DRAGGABLE: the generator has no attribute for it.

button.name: BtnVppClose
button.note: A child of the root, not of VppHeader, and above Header: inside VppHeader it would sit under the drag panel and never get a click.

panel.name: Rail
panel.note: Empty on purpose: the script puts one oz_vpp_rail_row in it per module and one per page of an open module, and keeps it as tall as the window allows.

panel.name: StatusBar
panel.note: The newest line of the journal and the config problems the last load reported. Anchored to the bottom, so the engine keeps it there; the script keeps it as wide as the window.

panel.name: ConfirmBar
panel.note: The confirm strip (design §3.4): a destructive action asks here, at the bottom of the page, instead of a second press. Shown by Confirm(), hidden by either button, Esc or another page; the script keeps it as wide as the content.

panel.name: Grip
panel.note: The resize grip, anchored to the bottom-right corner so it follows the window. The script makes it draggable and resizes the window while it is dragged.
